meta.window: 2025 + 2026 regular season (data as of the 2026-10-26 refresh)
meta.method: per-type distribution fitted on a 10,000-pitch sample from other pitchers (5 pitcher folds, seed 0): robust Mahalanobis (MinCovDet support .9) and isolation forest (300 trees, 512 subsamples), each z-scored against the type's training distribution; pitcher index = mean z over his pitches; ot = largest type mean z (>= 30 pitches)
meta.evidence_for_watching: 2026-10-27 outlier dummy test: top 5% isolation-forest dummy, K% RMSE better in 3 of 4 pairings (mean -.00005), flagged pitchers' K% residual +0.3 to +1.7 points in all four, coefficient +.003 to +.027; exploratory (one of 7 variants), 5-14 flagged pitchers per pairing.  Not in production.
meta.watch_rule: report only: after 2027, flagged pitchers' (flag_oi_if_top5, flag_oi_if_top10) mean K% residual vs the frozen production projection (prereg/c10_frozen_projections.json), PA-weighted, level-free, with a pitcher bootstrap
